purpose: Training-relatedness exclusion audit, not infection/assembly scoring
blastn_format: 7 qseqid sseqid evalue bitscore qlen slen qstart qend sstart send qseq sseq nident gaps

intergenomic_calculator.unsupported_cases: fail closed; do not replace missing similarities with zero

whole_genome_exclusion.graph: undirected connected components across all 99 genomes; exclude every source in target-containing components
whole_genome_exclusion.comparison: unrounded total-genome similarity; boundary cases excluded pending review
whole_genome_exclusion.rationale: 70% has phage genus-grouping precedent; connected components and boundary handling are conservative project leakage policies, not phenotype/taxonomy conclusions

tblastn_format: 7 qseqid sseqid pident qstart qend qlen sstart send sframe bitscore evalue

gp17_near_match.rule: exclude source genome with any single translated local alignment meeting both thresholds to either full-length target gp17
gp17_near_match.rationale: Explicit project near-homolog policy, not calibrated host-phenotype boundary; query coverage is not reciprocal full-protein coverage

broader_gp17_family_diagnostic.role: report broader remaining similarity for a separately frozen strict family-holdout sensitivity; do not silently treat retained genomes as homology-free

interpretation: Provisional sequence-relatedness audit. External calibration, host exclusions and complete training specification still required before model fitting; no target host scores or designs produced.
revision_reason: CDS translation verification and per-query BLAST completion controls; no threshold or alignment-parameter change; v1 stopped before accepted results
input_integrity_controls: verify gp17 annotation against exact CDS translation
require every outfmt7 query block, hit-row count and terminal query count
require each reference gp17 to recover its corresponding target genome at the frozen near-match threshold with the exact query length
